messages:
mateo: hey team, first-day onboarding question — my PR won't merge because GitHub shows a failing required check. Actions job failed with a 403 during checkout. PR: https://github.com/redwood/example/pull/12
samir: welcome! did you accept the org invite and SSO? 403 on checkout often means the GH app (actions) can't access the repo or the runner token is blocked.
mateo: I accepted the invite. Not on SSO yet (I clicked the link but it asked for org approval).
jen: ping infra-oncall to approve SSO if needed. also check branch protection: are required checks set to a specific context that doesn't exist?
mateo: branch protection shows required checks: buildkite/ci and github/actions. buildkite/ci is green for me but github/actions shows failed. logs:
```
Run actions/checkout@v3
Error: Request failed with status code 403
fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': No such device or address
```
mateo: not sure what account it's trying to use for the checkout step.
infra-oncall: @mateo i can take a look. quick q: is this PR from a fork or a branch in the main repo?
mateo: it's from a branch in the main repo (feature/mateo/dev-setup).
infra-oncall: ok. that rules out fork token scoping. did you recently rotate your personal access tokens or have a matched username mismatch? also, are there any repo-level policies that restrict checkout (like required seat/license)?
samir: another possibility — the GH Actions runner that writes artifacts is a self-hosted runner using an org token; if the org token was revoked the checkout step can fail with 403. i'll check the runners.
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/main" queued for PR #12 (job id: bk-4521).
merge-bot: merge blocked — required status checks failing: github/actions.
jen: @samir if you can't repro quickly, @infra-oncall can grant @mateo temporary bypass to merge (we prefer not) but main fix is get SSO/org app access sorted.
infra-oncall: i'm looking at org audit logs — saw a token rotation at 1903456000 for the actions-bot. switching runners to fallback cluster now. should be fixed in ~30s.
mateo: thanks — test running again now.
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/main" started for PR #12 (job id: bk-4522).
mateo: build finished ✅, checks passing. trying to merge now.
merge-bot: merge allowed — all required checks passed.
mateo: merged! thanks everyone :) first PR on the repo — excited to be here :tada:
jen: welcome aboard @mateo :tada: — if you hit any other onboarding CI quirks ping #eng-infra or @infra-oncall.
